name: Smartappcloud
description: Smartappcloud is a WhatsApp messaging gateway: send text and media messages to numbers and groups, manage WhatsApp Web instances, and receive events via webhooks.

events.d: Send a text or media message to a selected WhatsApp group.
Retrieve the WhatsApp groups available on the connected instance.
Send a text or media message to a WhatsApp number from the connected instance.
Retrieve the QR code to log the instance in to WhatsApp Web.
